final: WITH a AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS m FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(m) AS base FROM a), k AS (SELECT a.m AS m FROM a, b WHERE a.m > b.base), k2 AS (SELECT AVG(m) AS km FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.m AS m FROM k, k2 WHERE k.m > k2.km) SELECT AVG(f.m) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(f.m - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(f.m - k2.km) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM f, b, k2
